en: The postcard features a sepia-toned photograph of a residential building with a small garden at the front. A man stands at the entrance to the house, while two children and a large dog are on the path in front of the fence. The house facade has large windows, and there is a tree in the front yard. The lower border of the image has printed text. The reverse side is labeled 'Postkarte' and has a museum stamp from 'Museum im Schloss Bad Pyrmont', with other handwritten and printed notes.
